<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Touch of Lunacy](/Feats.aspx?ID=5507) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Curse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=566" />
<trait label="Morph" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=657" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=676" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 79

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486)

</column>

---

In moments of viciousness, your curse can partially infect your prey. Whenever you critically succeed with an [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719) attack from the werecreature archetype, the target must attempt a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC, or become [clumsy 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) until the beginning of your next turn as their bones elongate and form warps. On a critical failure, the target is also clumsy 1 for one minute as the transformation lingers.
name: Touch of Lunacy
